name: io.github.Turbotailz/farmos-mcp
description: Read and record farmOS 4.x assets, logs, plans, and terms over JSON:API. Stdio for local hosts, Streamable HTTP for ChatGPT and Gemini.

environmentVariables.name: FARMOS_URL
environmentVariables.description: farmOS base URL, https except for localhost

environmentVariables.name: FARMOS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth client id. Defaults to farm.

environmentVariables.name: FARMOS_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OAuth client secret for the client credentials grant

environmentVariables.name: FARMOS_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to enable create and update tools
